name: b11828
body:
<details open>

server: realtime API: send complete after committed audio drains (#30994)

* server: realtime API: send complete after committed audio drains

* server: realtime API: complete a commit at its end row

Completion is triggered when the stream runs dry, which is a timing
proxy: audio appended while the tail drains leaks into the committed
item, a final commit before the drain merges both items, and back to
back commits collapse into one.

mtmd_audio_stream_flush() records the row count at the end of the
flushed audio (mtmd_audio_stream_get_n_rows_flushed), next to the rows
produced so far (mtmd_audio_stream_get_n_rows). The slot keeps a FIFO
of these end rows and completes each commit once every row up to it is
decoded.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>
